design: network meta-analysis of randomized recipient-focused vaccine uptake interventions

design: systematic review and random-effects meta-analysis of adult randomized trials

design: meta-analysis
notes: Self-identity association with behavioral intention; this is not a direct identity-behavior causal estimate.

notes: Reminder interventions increased vaccination uptake; moderate-certainty network meta-analysis evidence.

design: meta-analysis of experimental social-dilemma studies

design: meta-analysis of experiments that significantly increased risk appraisal before measuring behavior

design: meta-analysis of experimental tests that successfully changed the target construct
